summary: Election workers write down the numbers of the seals on voting equipment and ballot boxes so a broken or swapped seal shows.
realLife: Georgia's rules for absentee voting say the registrars record the seal numbers on a daily recap sheet, and a ballot box that is resealed gets new seal numbers written down. Other states keep their own seal logs.
sources: Georgia Secretary of State, Rules and Regulations, Subject 183-1-14 Absentee Voting (rule 183-1-14-.02(13), "The registrars shall record the seal numbers on the daily recap sheet."): https://rules.sos.ga.gov/gac/183-1-14
inGame: the elections module's ballot and tally rows, read by the loading screen's progress step for elections (loading-steps.elections).

turns.what: A seal number does not match the log, so the ballots are set apart until it is explained.
turns.pulledBy: a mismatch found at a check
turns.writesBack: a flagged box row on the canvass

turns.what: The log is complete but a number was copied wrong and corrected the same day.
turns.writesBack: a corrected line on the daily sheet
